justification: Implementing GHG reduction targets can reinforce the implementation of GHG reduction targets in buildings, as both aim to reduce emissions and promote sustainable practices.
Reducing GHG emissions can aid in the transition to low-carbon transportation, supporting the implementation of GHG reduction targets in the transport sector.
Reducing GHG emissions can lead to increased food production and security, enabling more affordable and sustainable food options.
Lower GHG emissions can result in reduced pollution and healthier ecosystems, making it easier to reduce pesticide use and promote sustainable agriculture.
A low-carbon economy can support sustainable agriculture, enabling farmers to adopt more environmentally friendly practices and increase their competitiveness.
A just transition to a low-carbon economy can protect workers' rights and promote social cohesion, supporting the implementation of social security and worker protection measures.
Implementing GHG reduction targets in buildings can reinforce the overall GHG reduction strategy, supporting the achievement of EU climate goals.
Transitioning to low-carbon transportation can aid in reducing emissions and promoting sustainable practices, reinforcing the implementation of GHG reduction targets.
Promoting sustainable food systems can lead to increased food affordability, supporting the implementation of food affordability targets.
Improving animal welfare and promoting healthy diets can support the implementation of food quality targets, enabling the production of healthier and more sustainable food options.
Reducing food waste and promoting sustainable agriculture can support the reduction of pesticide use, enabling the implementation of pesticide reduction targets.
Reducing pesticide use can support sustainable agriculture, enabling farmers to adopt more environmentally friendly practices and increase their competitiveness.
Promoting competitive and sustainable agriculture can support the implementation of social security and worker protection measures, protecting farmers' livelihoods and promoting social cohesion.
